correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the 15 duads and all triples of duads covering the six symbols, making the 30-vertex cubic incidence graph. In the independent census, every matching corresponds to one injective sequence of adjacent synthemes in fixed duad order. Every complementary component is a cycle because all degrees are 2. Enumerating every pair of disjoint matchings and taking the edge-set remainder gives all unordered factorizations: the remainder has degree 1 at every vertex, and unordered triples are deduplicated. Reproduced 288 matchings with 144 of each profile (30) and (10,20), 144 distinct factorizations each with one (30) and two (10,20) complements, and incidences one and two respectively. Each factorization has exactly 3! distinct color-name assignments. Also enumerated the entire automorphism group independently of the packaged duality: the search tries every unassigned image at the correct distances to prior images; any automorphism satisfies this condition, and at a complete map it forces injectivity and preserves adjacency (distance one). The graph is connected. Obtained 1440 automorphisms (720 preserving the shores), which give two matching orbits with the stated profiles and one factorization orbit of size 144, so its stabilizer has order 10. Inspected both packaged verifiers and the representative CSV without executing any packaged code. Independent exact replay: python3 /workspace/review_evidence/4.py.
residual_risks: The exhaustive finite proof is for the fixed incidence graph only; it does not certify a family of graphs.

value.rationale: A natural complete classification of color-pair cycle profiles and equivalence classes for a canonical cubic cage. It determines exactly what complement structures a matching or coloring can exhibit, and shows a Hamiltonian pair is forced and unique in every coloring; the old scalar counts do not give this constraint. This supports precise comparisons of decompositions and symmetry actions without requiring a large-family extrapolation.
residual_risks: The finite classification does not assert a principle for other cages or determine all reconfiguration structures.
